sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant(s) submits that the dispute between the parties is a matrimonial dispute and in case, the matter is referred for mediation, the parties may get an opportunity to amicably settle their dispute.

He, therefore, submits that in view of the peculiar facts and circumstances of the present case, it will be in the interest of both the parties that the party may be referred for mediation to the Mediation Centre, High Court, Allahabad.
Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has no objection to this proposition.
Accordingly, the matter is referred to Mediation & Conciliation Centre of this Court.

The applicant(s) is/are directed to deposit a sum of Rs. 25,000/- by way of Demand Draft / pay order in the name of Registrar General A/c, Allahabad High Court Mediation & Conciliation Centre within a period of one month from today.

entities.text: Allahabad High Court Mediation & Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: After deposit of the aforesaid amount, office shall send a notice to the opposite party no.2 calling upon her to appear in the mediation proceedings.
Total amount of Rs. 25,000/- shall be payable to the opposite party no.2 on her appearance twice before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
The Mediation Centre will submit its report in the matter within three months.
List this case after three months alongwith the report of Mediation Centre.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant(s) in the aforesaid case.

If the amount, as directed above, is not deposited by the applicant(s) within the aforesaid period, the stay order shall automatically come to an end and the office shall immediately list this case for further orders before the Court.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned counsel for the applicant(s) submits that the dispute between the parties is a matrimonial dispute and in case, the matter is referred for mediation, the parties may get an opportunity to amicably settle their dispute.
Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has no objection to this proposition.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: He, therefore, submits that in view of the peculiar facts and circumstances of the present case, it will be in the interest of both the parties that the party may be referred for mediation to the Mediation Centre, High Court, Allahabad.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, the matter is referred to Mediation & Conciliation Centre of this Court.
The applicant(s) is/are directed to deposit a sum of Rs. 25,000/- by way of Demand Draft / pay order in the name of Registrar General A/c, Allahabad High Court Mediation & Conciliation Centre within a period of one month from today.
After deposit of the aforesaid amount, office shall send a notice to the opposite party no.2 calling upon her to appear in the mediation proceedings.
Total amount of Rs. 25,000/- shall be payable to the opposite party no.2 on her appearance twice before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
The Mediation Centre will submit its report in the matter within three months.
List this case after three months alongwith the report of Mediation Centre.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant(s) in the aforesaid case.
If the amount, as directed above, is not deposited by the applicant(s) within the aforesaid period, the stay order shall automatically come to an end and the office shall immediately list this case for further orders before the Court.
